summary: Full backend + frontend regression for TareasREC (PIN auth, member panel, admin tabs, member terminology). All 18 pytest cases passed. Playwright verified admin PIN 1209 login, wrong PIN clears dots, member PIN 4321 shows full dashboard with 7-day chart (Mié..Mar) plus every requested data-testid, admin tabs use 'Miembros'/'Agregar miembro'/'Miembros activos'/'Detalle por miembro' with zero occurrences of 'Empleada' anywhere. Screenshot file input has NO `capture` attribute (opens gallery). Logout works on both roles. New member creation + login + capture-attr check + cleanup validated end-to-end.

issues: Recharts console warning: 'The width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — non-blocking but indicates ResponsiveContainer receiving zero-sized parent briefly on tab switch
Radix DialogContent missing Description / aria-describedby (a11y console warning)

action_items: (Optional) EntriesList: render the `data-testid=my-entries-list` container even in the empty state so tests can assert on the section regardless of entries count.
(Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to the 'Nuevo miembro' modal to silence Radix warning.
(Optional) Give MyWeekChart / StatsTab charts an explicit min-height on parent to avoid Recharts (-1) width/height warning on first paint of a hidden tab.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py imports `date` from datetime; uses `date.today()` throughout — assumes server timezone. Consider using timezone-aware 'today' (America/Guatemala or similar) so the daily 409 duplicate-guard aligns with the member's local day.
POST /api/entries picks extension from filename; content-type header is trusted for storage upload — consider validating mime against magic bytes.
startup admin upsert always overwrites `code`/`name`/`email` on the existing admin, which is fine, but if code rotation is desired via env this should be documented.
No rate-limiting or brute-force lockout on /auth/login (spec's auth playbook mentions lockout after 5 fails). This app uses only a 4-digit PIN so brute force is a real concern.
Frontend EntryForm accepts up to 4 chars for minutes but silently caps to 4 digits (max 9999); backend caps at 1440. UI should also validate <=1440 to avoid a round-trip 400.
